messages:
maria: FYI billing alert — unexpected network/egress spike from eu-west-1 over last 6h, ~ $7.2k. hourly ramped at 03:10 UTC. looks related to logs/traces. :eyes:
ajohnson: Ooh. Any cloud invoice link or cost id? can we map to SKU/region?
kevin: I pulled a quick view from bigquery exports, looks like egress SKU: "Inter-Region Network Egress (Europe -> US)" spike. possible shard replication?
olivia: can someone paste the raw cost query? i'll run more granular by service and label.
maria: pasted raw alert: "Billing anomaly: project=redwood-prod, service=Network egress, region=eu-west-1 -> us-east4, delta=$7200, window=6h"
sre-oncall: I'm toggling trace-exporter to rate-limit mode for eu clusters (will reduce outgoing bandwidth). standby. :wrench:
ajohnson: running live check: `gcloud logging read "resource.labels.location=\"europe-west1\" AND protoPayload.serviceName:trace" --limit 100 --format json` to see exporters.
kevin: quick grep on our fluentd config git history — merged change earlier today that enabled cross-region forwarder for retained traces. PR #4823 changed `forward.target` to `us-east4-indexer` instead of local-archive. likely culprit.
maria: that matches timing. who rolled #4823?
kevin: rolled by olivia at 02:55 UTC via 1-click deploy. can we roll back?
olivia: I rolled to unblock ingestion backlog, didn't realize forward target was cross-region. my bad — i thought it was internal mirror. rolling back now. will post deploy id. :wave:
sre-oncall: rollback acknowledged, also paused background archive replays (cron: trace-replay) to avoid double traffic.
kevin: adding a short BigQuery cost snippet i used to verify:```SELECT service.description, sku.description, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `company_billing.gcp_export.gcp_billing` 
WHERE usage_start_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 6 HOUR)
AND project.id = 'redwood-prod'
AND sku.description LIKE '%Egress%'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 10;```
ajohnson: results show three large blobs to us-east4 from eu-west1, total ~7.1k. object sizes ~100-200MB each, many repeated. looks like duplicated shards from replayer + forwarder.
maria: good catch. action items: 1) rollback complete? 2) pause replayer cron 3) open billing dispute for immediate window if we can (contact cloud support) 4) postmortem + tagging for cost center
olivia: rollback finished at 03:18 UTC — deploy id deploy-20260318-olivia-17. replayer paused.
sre-oncall: I'll file ticket with cloud support (case #CS-88921) requesting expedited review, note the pattern is replication duplication not sustained steady state.
billing-bot: New invoice chunk linked: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/0201/costs?project=redwood-prod (shows line items).
kevin: long-term fix ideas: require region labels on forwarder configs, CI check to block cross-region forward targets, and guard rails in deploy UI to show estimated egress.
ajohnson: also add quota alert on network egress per-project to detect above-baseline early.
maria: agreed. i'll create a short ticket with owner, assign to kevin for CI check, olivia for deploy UI change, and ops for billing dispute.
kevin: PR will include a pre-deploy egress estimate based on bytes/sec * target region pricing table. rough ETA 2w.
maria: thanks all. looping in finance for cost allocation and to update forecast. :thumbsup:
olivia: apologies again. learning: never change forward.target without region flag. adding checklist entry now.
kevin: adding final note: we should also scan past 48h for similar bursts in other projects — could be a templated config mistake. I'll run that tomorrow morning.
maria: closing loop here, mark incident status: mitigated. will keep thread open for postmortem notes.
